posts.title: Enforcement over alignment and steering
posts.description: I'm building an open-source Claude Code plugin called The Enforcer . Not because I fancy writing more rules, but because asking a coding agent nicely to behave is clearly not enough. If something must happen, I don't want to cross my fingers and hope the model remembers. I want the system to make the wrong thing hard to do. posts.title: Underground. The world was open in 1987, if you had a modem
posts.description: A long way from Melbourne, in my local library in North Queensland, I read Underground by Suelette Dreyfus, and it has captivated me ever since. It came out in 1997 and tells the true story of the hackers of the late 80s and early 90s.
